hook.line: Gabby Thomas was the first one we announced as part of this race.
hook.visual: Podcast-mic shot of the speaker in a cap, then a cut at 0.6 s to Olympic sprint footage with small white captions

beats.what: Speaker at a podcast mic, one line before the first cut
Cut to Olympic sprint race footage under the voice
Cut to stage footage of the interview with the athlete
Speaker cut out over the prize table, a circle around the $30,000 first prize
Moody athlete b-roll on 'you cannot be a professional athlete'
Stage announcement footage at the summit
Zoom punch into the stage shot as they announce doubling the prize
Back to the speaker at the mic for the $60K line

why_it_works: Cut at 0.6 s from a static mic shot to race footage gives motion in the first second
A circled $30,000 on a real prize table turns the problem into a number the viewer can see
Problem then fix ($30K to $60K) in under 45 s, a full story arc with a clear payoff
A cut every 3 s of b-roll keeps a podcast monologue moving
weaknesses: No CTA in the video; the ticket link lives only in the caption
Small low-contrast captions are easy to miss over busy footage
Ends mid-sentence on the payoff, which may feel cut off
for_robert: Show the key number on a real document with a circle around it when making a claim; Fred could draw the circle.
